editorial: Today, in the world of mathematics, ambitious proof attempts regarding the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis and technical improvements in AI models focused on safety and causality are coming to the fore. In particular, new small language models and action-oriented vision-language models published on the Hugging Face platform provide current data for improving the safe stopping capabilities of systems.

items.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
items.summary: Claude-BugHunter is a Claude Code capability package developed for bug hunting and external red-team efforts. It offers 82 capabilities, 15 slash commands, and a comprehensive security report database to identify vulnerabilities in software development processes.

snapshot.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: obra/superpowers offers composable skills and a software development methodology for AI coding agents. This framework aims to create standardized instructions and workflows that agents can use while performing their tasks.

snapshot.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works. Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.

items.title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
items.summary: CLI-Anything is a command-line interface (CLI) tool that makes software tools suitable for use by AI agents. This system provides a compatible working environment with various AI platforms such as Pi, OpenClaw, nanobot, the code editor Cursor, and Claude Code.

snapshot.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: One Command Line: Make any software agent-ready for Pi, OpenClaw, nanobot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc. 中文文档 | 日本語ドキュメント | Deutsch

items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.summary: jingyaogong/minimind is a project that allows for training a 64M parameter large language model (LLM) from scratch on personal devices within two hours. It aims for users to understand the internal working mechanisms of the model from the ground up, rather than just fine-tuning existing AI models.

snapshot.description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours. 大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的出现，引发了全球范围内对 AI 的空前关注。无论是 ChatGPT、DeepSeek 还是 Qwen，都以惊艳的效果让人真切感受到这场技术浪潮的冲击力。然而，动辄数百亿参数的模型规模，使得它们对个人设备而言不仅难以训练，甚至连部署都显得遥不可及。打开大模型的“黑盒子”，真正去理解其内部运作机制，本应是一件令人心潮澎湃的事。遗憾的是，绝大多数探索最终都止步于使用 LoRA 等技术对现有大模型做少量微调，学习一些新指令或特定任务。这更像是在教牛顿如何使用 21 世纪的智能手机——虽然有趣，却偏离了理解物理本质的初衷。

items.title: cursor/plugins
items.summary: Cursor offers a repository containing the technical standards and official extensions developed for the code editing tool Cursor. Prepared in the TypeScript language, this resource includes the rules and examples necessary for developers to create platform-specific plugins.

snapshot.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins

items.title: firecrawl/firecrawl
items.summary: Firecrawl is an information infrastructure that provides access to over 550 data providers through a single application programming interface (API) to facilitate data access for AI agents. This solution, which developers can host on their own servers, includes software development kits (SDKs) that standardize web scraping and data collection processes.

snapshot.description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API. Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. 🔥 You can use Firecrawl three ways. This repo holds the code for Firecrawl Local and the self-hosted server, along with SDKs that work with all three.

items.title: nginx/nginx
items.summary: NGINX is open-source software used as a web server, load balancer, reverse proxy, API gateway, and content cache. Developed in the C language, this popular technology is widely preferred globally for managing network traffic and serving content.

snapshot.description: The official NGINX Open Source repository. NGINX (pronounced "engine x" or "en-jin-eks") is the world's most popular Web Server, high performance Load Balancer, Reverse Proxy, API Gateway and Content Cache.

items.title: openvinotoolkit/openvino
items.summary: OpenVINO is an open-source toolkit used to optimize and deploy the inference processes of AI models. Developed in the C++ language, this platform enables models to run more efficiently on different hardware.

snapshot.description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference. Check out the OpenVINO Cheat Sheet and Key Features for a quick reference.

items.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.summary: Cathrynlavery/diagram-design offers 45 different types of editorial schema designs for developer tools such as Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. This work provides shadow-free and dependency-free HTML and SVG-based visualization options.

snapshot.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary: mvanhorn/last30days-skill is an AI skill that provides summaries on current topics by conducting research across various platforms (Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web). Developed in Python, this tool aims to synthesize data obtained from different sources to provide the user with a reliable summary.

snapshot.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

items.title: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
items.summary: stitch-skills, developed by Google Labs, is a library of agent skills designed to work compatibly with the Stitch MCP server. This library follows open standards to ensure compatibility with software such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and the code editing tool Cursor.

snapshot.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.

items.title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance
items.summary: mjmirza/app-store-compliance is an open-source guide that offers 117 different error patterns and solution suggestions to prevent app store rejection processes. The tool, which allows software developers to track legal compliance dates, also includes an integrated capability set for AI coding agents.

snapshot.description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 117 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 95 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.

items.title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre
items.summary: Tracer-Cloud/opensre is an open-source AI agent designed to increase the reliability of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes. Developed in Python, this tool helps manage software updates by simplifying the installation process.

snapshot.description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability. The installer fetches the latest build from main without requiring sudo. If opensre is not found, follow the PATH instructions printed by the installer or open a new terminal.

items.title: toeverything/AFFiNE
items.summary: AFFiNE is a next-generation knowledge base that combines planning, editing, and content creation processes into a single platform. Privacy-focused and open-source (with source code accessible and open for development by everyone), this software offers a workspace as an alternative to tools like Notion and Miro.

snapshot.description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.

items.title: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3
items.summary: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3 is a comprehensive download manager that runs on four different platforms and supports almost all download protocols. Starting from a Bilibili content creator's resource management need, the project now has an ecosystem that can be expanded with feature packs.

snapshot.description: The only downloader you need. 下载器的集大成者。. Started as a passion project to help a Bilibili creator manage resources. Now it ships on four platforms, handles virtually every download protocol, and has a growing Feature Packs plugin ecosystem.

items.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
items.summary: AutoClip is an open-source desktop video editing tool that automatically converts long videos into short clips. The software prepares subtitles and covers for the content and creates suitable sharing texts for social media platforms.

snapshot.description: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.

items.title: Levent Alpöge claims proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis [pdf]
items.summary: Mathematician Levent Alpöge announced that he has presented a proof for the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, one of the most important problems in number theory. This claim has sparked a new debate in the academic community over this complex mathematical assumption, which has been the subject of ongoing search for a solution.

snapshot.description: Related: Hurried Announcement: Alessandro Masullo GRH - https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50579568

items.title: Hurried Announcement: Alessandro Masullo GRH
items.summary: The GRH study announced by Alessandro Masullo is associated with Levent Alpöge's claims that he has proven the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis. This development, which has attracted great interest in the mathematical world, is creating a new environment for debate regarding the validity of the hypothesis.

snapshot.description: Related: Levent Alpöge claims proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis [pdf] - https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50574968

items.title: Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary: Developed by Thinking Machines, Inkling 2 Mini is an open-weights AI model small enough to run on laptops. The model uses an architecture that loops its middle layers to perform more reasoning and generate responses using fewer tokens.

snapshot.description: Inkling 2 Mini is an open-weights model small enough to run on your laptop. It loops its middle layers to reason more per token and reach answers in fewer tokens.

items.title: Restricting AI agents in mobile operating systems platforms from capturing data
items.summary: Signal is restricting AI agents integrated into mobile operating systems from recording and processing user data. This move aims to preserve the messaging app's privacy-focused operating principle.

snapshot.description: Privacy is our mission; it’s why we exist, and we do everything we can to protect it. This means that we are restricting the latest AI agents built into mobile operating systems from potentially capturing and storing your Signal data.

items.title: Unforced Navier-Stokes Singularity and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis
items.summary: Mathematician Terry Tao shares new findings on the Navier-Stokes singularity and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis on his personal blog. These results, contributed to by names such as Levent Alpöge and Tristan Buck, include current developments toward solving fundamental problems in theoretical physics and mathematics.

snapshot.description: Obviously these results will be reported widely in other outlets, but I will note them here, in decreasing order of how “digested” the results currently are: Levent Alpöge, Tristan Buck…

items.title: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini is a multimodal AI model that processes text and image inputs to produce text output. Supporting various programming languages as well as English and other languages, this general-purpose model offers versatile usage.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Inkling 2 Mini is a general-purpose multimodal model that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is intended for use in English and other languages, and across multiple coding languages.

items.title: higurashi-ai/Haru-4B
items.summary: Published on Hugging Face, Haru-4B is a low-latency, multilingual audio-to-audio foundation model. Offering a continuous spoken dialogue experience where humans can listen and speak at the same time, just like in phone calls, this model has been released for research purposes.

snapshot.description: audio-to-audio model. Haru-4B is a low-latency and multilingual full-duplex continuous spoken dialogue foundation model: it listens and speaks at the same time, the way people do on a phone call. It is a pretrained base model, released for research.

items.title: Sentinel7/h3
items.summary: Sentinel7/h3, shared on Hugging Face, is a model file made available to users. The content in question is accessible via the model hosting and sharing infrastructure provided by the platform.

items.title: harness-hub/Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted
items.summary: Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted, developed by Harness-hub, is an image-text-to-text generation model customized for software development and terminal tasks. It has been optimized for the pi coding agent using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and reinforcement learning techniques applied to the Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B model.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. A LoRA adapter for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, trained with reinforcement learning to work as the model behind the pi coding agent on software-engineering and terminal tasks.

items.title: unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF
items.summary: unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF, shared on Hugging Face, is an artificial intelligence model that converts image and text inputs into text. The 4-bit version of the model can be run on platforms such as Blender and MCP (Model Context Protocol) using the Unsloth optimization tool.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. See an example of 4-bit Inkling Mini running in Unsloth in Blender + MCP:

items.title: Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
items.summary: The paper 'Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery', shared on Hugging Face, addresses the statistical challenges encountered in causal discovery processes in time series. The study introduces a new constraint-based method called Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery (ITPD) to improve computational and sample efficiency in these complex data structures.

snapshot.description: Learning and inference on time series can pose significant statistical challenges, including autocorrelated observations, distribution shift over time, and the curse of dimensionality. These challenges complicate the practical application of causal discovery algorithms, which already suffer from high computational and sample complexity in the general case. To mitigate these issues, this work introduces Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery (ITPD): a sound and complete constraint-based procedure fo

items.title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
items.summary: The paper published on Hugging Face examines the ability of vision-language-action models to safely halt prohibited behaviors during robotic tasks. The study focuses on the challenges of controlling physical responses, noting that existing models can continue to complete tasks even when interrupted.

snapshot.description: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform diverse tasks from visual observations and language instructions. While prior work has explored task suppression and refusal, stopping prohibited behavior once execution is underway and controlling the resulting physical response remain challenging. Our evaluation reveals that policies which suppress a task from its initial state can still complete it when taking over partway through execution. Even when the task remains unfinished, th

items.title: PAD: Policy-Aware Data Valuation for Autonomous Driving
items.summary: The paper 'PAD: Policy-Aware Data Valuation for Autonomous Driving', shared by Hugging Face, presents a new method for determining data value in end-to-end autonomous driving systems. The study aims to perform policy-aware data valuation in training processes by measuring the impact of data on different planners.

snapshot.description: End-to-end autonomous driving increasingly depends on scaling training demonstrations, yet data growth does not guarantee proportional gains. However, additional data do not guarantee better policies: a demonstration that benefits one planner may be redundant or harmful to another. Existing curation methods typically infer data value from intrinsic sample properties or training-dependent proxies that do not measure downstream policy utility. To address this, we introduce Policy-Aware Data Valuat

items.title: Lang-SVG: Hierarchical Image Vectorization with Language Priors
items.summary: Lang-SVG, shared by Hugging Face, is a method that converts images into editable and structured Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) format. This study aims to create a tree structure more suitable for human perception in the vectorization process by combining object hierarchies with language priors.

snapshot.description: Image vectorization reconstructs raster images as compact scalable vector graph- ics (SVG), providing a structured and editable code representation of images. However, most existing vectorization methods optimize for pixel-level render- ing fidelity, often producing SVGs that lack alignment with human-perceived object-part hierarchies, making them difficult to manipulate. To address this, we propose Lang-SVG, which introduces an explicit tree structure to organize SVG primitives with semantic la

items.title: Squoosh Bench: Evaluating UX-1 on 318 Historical Website A/B Tests
items.summary: Squoosh Bench is an evaluation study conducted on 318 different A/B tests to predict the performance of website changes. The Squoosh UX-1 model, fine-tuned with human browsing data, aims to predict test results through simulated user behaviors.

snapshot.description: Experimentation teams must decide which proposed website changes to test with live traffic. We evaluated whether forecasts from simulated shoppers could inform that choice. We screened 412 historical website A/B tests and evaluated four systems on the 318 that ran longer than 21 days. Each system predicted an original win, a variant win, or an inconclusive result. glossary.explanation: A systematic research process conducted to find bugs or security vulnerabilities in software.
A security audit that mimics the methods of malicious attackers to test the security of a system.
Short text commands starting with a slash symbol to quickly execute features of a software.
Specialized capability modules added to a system to enable artificial intelligence agents to perform specific tasks.
A text-based interface that runs programs with written commands instead of a mouse.
Artificial intelligence models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
The process of retraining a pre-trained artificial intelligence model with smaller datasets to achieve better results for a specific task.
Small add-on software components used to extend the features of a main software or provide it with new functions.
A digital connection point that allows different software to exchange data with each other.
A set of tools and code libraries that make it easier for developers to build applications for a specific platform or system.
Software that prevents system crashes by distributing incoming internet traffic evenly across multiple servers.
An intermediary system that handles requests from the internet, directs them to the appropriate server, and hides the server's identity.
A gateway software that collects, manages, and routes all requests from different services at a single point.
A type of software where the source code is open for anyone to inspect, modify, and improve.
The stage where a trained artificial intelligence model uses new data to generate predictions or results.
A capability unit that enables an artificial intelligence agent to perform a specific task, such as conducting research on a platform and generating a summary.
